view: From the Museum Campus lakefront by the Shedd Aquarium, looking north-north-west across Monroe Harbor (Lake Michigan, with a glint) at the Loop, Lakeshore East and Streeterville; Grant Park trees along the shore and South Loop towers on the left. The signature towers are pushed together into the hero zone in their real left-to-right order, each drawn at one scale (0.18 dp per metre) from its real bearing, so heights and plan widths are true.
